column2:
My dear [Root.GetTitledName]
The Knights Mariner have long sought a harbour from which to guard the seas in Manann's name and keep [Root.Religion.GetGroupName] ships safe from corsairs and worse. We think your newfound lands in [potential_title.GetBaseName] would make the perfect stronghold, and we would pay you for your troubles.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Whatever the [d_knights_mariner.GetName] want, I offer.
§Y[potential_title.GetBaseName]§! is given to §Y[From.GetTitledName]§!.
No, I need these lands.
The Knights Mariner of [potential_title.GetBaseName]

The magnanimous [From.GetTitledName] has donated the island of [potential_title.GetBaseName] to the Knights Mariner, the sea-going order of Manann. From their new harbour the knights will hunt the corsairs and raiders that plague the shipping lanes, and [d_knights_mariner.Holder.GetTitledFirstName] vows to keep the waters safe for all faithful sailors of the Old World.
Manann watch over the Knights of [potential_title.GetBaseName].

[Root.GetTitledName]
The White Wolves would finally drive the enemies of Ulric from the north, and your newly won lands of [holy_order_potential_title.GetBaseName] would serve us as a march against the Wastes. We will pay you well for them, for we would not insult a lord of your standing.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
I would be glad to help the [d_knights_of_the_white_wolf.GetName]!
§Y[holy_order_potential_title.GetBaseName]§! is given to §Y[d_knights_of_the_white_wolf.Holder.GetTitledName]§!.
My apologies, but these lands are my own.
The White Wolves in [holy_order_potential_title.GetName]

Supported by the charitable [From.GetTitledName], the Knights of the White Wolf have settled in [holy_order_potential_title.GetBaseName]. Sworn to drive the enemies of the faith from the north, [d_knights_of_the_white_wolf.Holder.GetTitledName] has begun fortifying [holy_order_potential_title.GetName] as a staging ground for the wars to come.\n\nFrom [FromFrom.Capital.GetName], it is only a matter of time before Ulric's knights carry their hammers across the rest of [kingdom_title.GetBaseName]. The northmen look towards the new seat of the White Wolves with fear and hatred.
It is only a matter of time before the north falls to them.

[Root.GetTitledName]
I write to tell you that my brothers and I have left your service. We no longer hold you fit to command the sworn swords of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], and from this day we answer to the god alone.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Cursed zealots!
Sea-Compass of the Knights Mariner
A brass compass from a harbour of the Knights Mariner, given in thanks to a lord who gave the order a home. Sailors swear its needle swings toward the favour of Manann as surely as toward the north.
Pelt of the White Wolf
A great wolf pelt, like those the Knights of the White Wolf wear over their armour, given in thanks to a lord who helped the order march north. It still smells of pine smoke and snow.
